proposedClusterReconciliations.reason: The original aggregation-versus-migration and destination/colour/checking intent is materially answered in current prose. Provider copies, account identity, workplace authority, plan limits, duplicate routes, and harmless two-direction checks are explicit. Retaining comparison_pending would ignore actual completed editorial work; marking the whole merge intent complete would overstate it.

intentAssessment.intent: Multiple calendars in one view / combine Google and Outlook for personal planning
intentAssessment.evidence: Provider overview sections 1–6 identify accounts, iOS versus direct connection, Google/Base and Microsoft/Premium, provider permissions, mirror sources, selected destinations and verification.

intentAssessment.intent: Replace app switching without deleting accounts or confusing copies
intentAssessment.evidence: Three-calendar-apps sections 1–6 keep workplace apps, inspect existing routes, test a disposable owned appointment and separate notifications from view selection.

intentAssessment.intent: Work/personal colour labels, destinations and shared availability
intentAssessment.evidence: Work-and-personal sections 1–5 explain colours, visibility, destination, approved manual busy block and recipient-side verification without asserting automated masking.

intentAssessment.intent: Merge/migrate stored events into one destination calendar
intentAssessment.evidence: Current guides explain why an overview is not a merge and why a move can affect the source. They do not provide a provider-specific transfer validation/rollback procedure. This is not evidence the entire site lacks export guidance.

remainingIntentGaps.gap: A reader using merge to mean actual migration still needs a clear next action.
remainingIntentGaps.action: In the existing provider overview, add a compact goal choice: view selected sources / move owned events / replicate availability. Refer actual transfer seekers to the existing export guide after reviewing that guide; do not invent a Cloud bulk merge control or repeat an import procedure without provider support.

remainingIntentGaps.gap: Automatic cross-account availability replication is not established as a Cloud capability.
remainingIntentGaps.action: Keep the explicit boundary and existing sync/OneCal related guide. Do not create a generic automation article from competitor discovery alone.

proposedClusterReconciliations.reason: The stated layered decision sequence is present across full guides: ownership/provider view, same identity, visible versus absent calendars, two-device direction checks, Google selection and bounded retrieval, title/current-year search, duplicates and safe escalation. Generic troubleshooting is substantive; universal provider repair and recovery are not established.

intentAssessment.intent: Calendar not syncing between iPhone and iPad
intentAssessment.evidence: Sync guide sections 1–5 distinguish connection types and perform a harmless provider/direction comparison, without a fixed refresh promise or reset-first advice.

intentAssessment.intent: A Google calendar or event is missing
intentAssessment.evidence: Google missing-calendar guide sections 1–6 separately checks web identity/access, hidden versus absent calendars, iOS versus direct routes, selection, exact dates and support escalation. It does not promise every accessible calendar appears.

Old-event guide sections 1–6 identifies title matching, current-year app search, provider advanced search, browsing versus search and local calendar absence of an assumed cloud archive. No guarantee of recovery.

intentAssessment.intent: Two copies disagree or appear duplicated
intentAssessment.evidence: Disagreement guide sections 1–5 checks record identity, provider view, time zone, recurrence and permissions, rejects universal last-edit-wins, hides/restores visibility and verifies one authorised correction.

remainingIntentGaps.gap: Readers have to assemble the symptom branches from several guides.
remainingIntentGaps.action: Add a short diagnostic routing list to what-calendar-sync-actually-does: calendar absent / listed but unchecked / exact event date absent / title search empty / two entries differ. Link each to the existing specific guide. This is navigation of existing depth, not a demand for another article.

remainingIntentGaps.gap: A generated destination copy from a separate replication service is not worked through as an explicit example in the disagreement guide.
remainingIntentGaps.action: Add one bounded example under Hide first: identify the original provider event, the separate destination calendar and the service that created it; hiding a displayed calendar does not remove a stored destination copy. Point disconnect decisions to the existing disconnect guide; do not invent clone markers or cleanup outcomes.

remainingIntentGaps.gap: Exact provider/client repair procedures and service-specific history limits remain outside this body review.
remainingIntentGaps.action: Do not claim universal iCloud/Microsoft/shared-resource troubleshooting, full archive loading or recovery. Before expanding a provider branch, reread its current official help and the existing Exchange/help guides. Readdle troubleshooting remains an index-only original discovery; it is not a completed substantive source read.
